# Cornelia Bryant

## Overview

- **Age:** Over fifty years old in Volume 1; fifty-nine by Volume 2  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044), [v2 c26 P20](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0020)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v4 c37 P4](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0004), [v4 c37 P10](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife and community organizer  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Rachel Lynde's husband (referring to her husband Thomas)  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Cornelia Bryant is a plump, fresh, pink-and-white-faced woman with jolly brown eyes and a hard little knob of fair hair bound by an elastic band. She is short and stout, weighing about two hundred pounds, and walks with a brisk, matronly gait. She wears spectacles and is often seen in a chocolate print wrapper with pink roses or her Sunday navy blue silk.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v2 c6 P0](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0000), [v2 c6 P11](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0011), [v4 c8 P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 c8 P20](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0020), [v4 c37 P26](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0026)_

## Personality

Cornelia Bryant is an outspoken, sharp-tongued woman with a caustic wit and strong, unyielding opinions, particularly regarding men, whom she claims to despise. Despite her crusty exterior, sharp tongue, and habit of criticizing others, she possesses a deeply kind heart and is always the first to offer practical help in times of trouble. She is an energetic, thrifty housekeeper who prides herself on her independence and her staunch Presbyterian faith.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c6 P9](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0009), [v2 c9 P9](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0009), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040)_

- To care for and support Leslie Moore through her trials  <sub>[v2 c11 P29](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0029), [v4 c11 P41](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0041)</sub>
- To improve the community through the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and church work  <sub>[v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010)</sub>

## History

Cornelia Bryant lived for many years as an independent spinster in her green-painted house on the Four Winds harbor road. A staunch Presbyterian and outspoken critic of men, she devoted much of her time to helping those in need throughout the community, particularly taking a protective interest in Leslie Moore. Although she claimed to despise men and vowed never to marry, she eventually accepted her long-time suitor, Marshall Elliott, after he fulfilled a twenty-year political vow by shaving his beard upon the election of a Liberal government. Following their marriage, Marshall moved into her home at Four Winds. She later took in Mary Vance, an orphaned girl, bringing her up with strict discipline and affection. Throughout the years, Cornelia remained a loyal friend to Anne and Gilbert Blythe, frequently visiting their house of dreams and later Ingleside, offering her sharp-tongued commentary, practical help, and steadfast support.

_Sources: [v2 c3 P0](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0000), [v2 c6 P40](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0040), [v2 c11 P29](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0029), [v4 c6 P36](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0036), [v4 c9 P35](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0035), [v4 c37 P4](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0004), [v4 c37 P14](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0014), [v5 c1 P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 c9 P43](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0043)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Four Winds and had many suitors in her youth before deciding to remain single  <sub>[v2 c3 P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 c25 P25](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0025)</sub>
- Had a younger brother who died in his early twenties, whom she raised after her mother died
- Took Mary Vance into her home as a handmaiden to rescue her from an abusive situation  <sub>[v5 c9 P43](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0043)</sub>
